tool_calls.input:
const cmd = `python3 -B -c 'import collections,json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from tools.i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from tools.i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from tools.i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
root=Path.cwd(); commit="8153e982f660f2f7907d4ad7d19070cfd3bf4818"; loader=LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
work=json.loads((root/".ai/task/repair-w38-20260926/WORKSET.json").read_text()); expected=collections.Counter((x["normalized_path"],x["section"],x["source"],x["source_tag"],x["target_preimage"]) for x in work["items"])
changed=[]; counts={}; per_file={}; line_shifts={}
for name in ("tome-cults.lua","tome-orcs.lua"):
 old=loader.load_bytes(subprocess.check_output(["git","show",f"{commit}:{name}"]),logical_path=name).records; new=loader.load_path(root/name,logical_path=name).records; counts[name]=len(new); assert len(old)==len(new)
 shifts=set(); per_file[name]=0
 for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(old,new)):
  aa=dict(a); bb=dict(b); at=aa.pop("target",None); bt=bb.pop("target",None); shifts.add(bb.pop("line")-aa.pop("line")); assert aa==bb,(name,i,"non-target drift")
  if at!=bt: assert a.get("kind")=="translation"; changed.append((name,a,b,at,bt)); per_file[name]+=1
 line_shifts[name]=sorted(shifts)
actual=collections.Counter((name,a["section"],a["source"],a.get("source_tag"),at) for name,a,b,at,bt in changed); assert actual==expected,(expected-actual,actual-expected); assert len(changed)==24
fmt=re.compile(r"%%|%(?:\\d+\\\\$)?[-+0#]*(?:\\d+|\\\\*)?(?:\\\\.(?:\\d+|\\\\*))?[hlL]?[diuoxXfFeEgGaAcspq]"); tag=re.compile(r"#[A-Za-z_{}]+#"); tpl=re.compile(r"<\\\\?=?[^?]*\\\\?>")
for name,a,b,at,bt in changed:
 sl=a["source"].split("\\\\n"); tl=bt.split("\\\\n"); lead=lambda x:len(x)-len(x.lstrip("\\\\t")); assert len(sl)==len(tl),(name,a["line"],"line count"); assert [lead(x) for x in sl]==[lead(x) for x in tl],(name,a["line"],"leading TAB"); assert [i for i,x in enumerate(sl) if x==""]==[i for i,x in enumerate(tl) if x==""],(name,a["line"],"blank lines"); assert a["source"].endswith("\\\\n")==bt.endswith("\\\\n"),(name,a["line"],"terminal newline"); assert fmt.findall(a["source"])==fmt.findall(bt),(name,a["line"],"printf"); assert collections.Counter(tag.findall(a["source"]))==collections.Counter(tag.findall(bt)),(name,a["line"],"markup"); assert collections.Counter(tpl.findall(a["source"]))==collections.Counter(tpl.findall(bt)),(name,a["line"],"templates")
print(json.dumps({"luajit_files_loaded":2,"record_counts":counts,"target_changes":len(changed),"target_changes_per_file":per_file,"workset_exact":True,"non_target_record_content_unchanged":True,"expected_line_shifts_from_target_line_restoration":line_shifts,"line_tab_blank_terminal_newline_invariants":True,"printf_markup_template_invariants":True},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))'`;
const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd,workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",yield_time_ms:30000,max_output_tokens:20000,sandbox_permissions:"require_escalated",justification:"允许我用仓库自带 LuaJIT loader 对基线与当前两个译文文件做有界逐记录验收吗？"}); text(r.output); if (r.exit_code) text(`exit ${r.exit_code}`);
